# Explain how to test and debug DockLayouts end to end

## Context

DockLayouts has an unusually deep evidence surface: pure model units, component fixtures, headed whitebox E2E, Neural Link worker/main inspection, rendered theme checks, mutation controls, and external-Brain runtime gates. The generic testing guides cannot encode the subsystem-specific evidence boundaries.

## The Problem

Maintainers repeatedly get green-looking wrong answers by sampling the wrong plane, using stale theme output, skipping the external runtime gate, observing live DOM instead of VDOM ownership, or treating a test tally as failure disposition. There is no guide explaining how to choose an instrument that can contain the DockLayouts answer.

## The Architectural Reality

The current suite spans `test/playwright/{unit,component,e2e}/dashboard`, Workstation whitebox journeys, theme fixtures, and Neural Link. Model truth, App-worker component truth, VDOM delivery, painted DOM, and physical windows are distinct observation surfaces; custom Playwright configs and headed execution are mandatory for different questions.

## The Fix

Create `learn/guides/testing/DockLayoutsTesting.md`: an evidence-first guide to reproducing, observing, mutating, and debugging DockLayouts across its model, worker, DOM, and window planes.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Testing guide | Current DockLayouts unit/component/E2E suites + Neural Link | Teach instrument choice by authority plane and failure class | Re-census suite at pickup | New guide | Red-first and mutation receipts |
| Runtime gates | Current Playwright configs + external Brain root behavior | Explain when a listed test is actually discoverable/executable | Fail closed on missing runtime | Same guide | List/run controls |
| Registration | Existing testing-guide siblings | One discoverable Testing guide | No generated-output edits | tree + SEO inputs | lint + rendered portal |

## Decision Record

Not needed; this guide explains evidence collection.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The guide clears the full guide-authoring bar: source/tool-grounded narrative, reader-owned benefits, lived maintainer voice, and at least one render-verified `flowchart TD`.
- [ ] The guide separates explanation from reference: no inlined API/schema/test catalog, and no ticket or PR ids in guide prose.
- [ ] The new source guide is registered in `learn/tree.json` and the SEO `PRIORITIES` input; generated sitemap/LLM outputs remain untouched.
- [ ] Current-source consistency, guide lint, tree lint, portal rendering, and an independent cross-family whole-guide review are recorded in the PR.
- [ ] The guide maps model, App worker, VDOM, DOM/paint, main-thread geometry, and physical-window questions to instruments that can observe them.
- [ ] It uses current custom unit/component/E2E configurations and demonstrates at least one red-first reproduction plus a mutation control.
- [ ] It explains external-Brain runtime discovery, headed requirements, theme freshness, deterministic versus batch-order failures, and privacy-safe diagnostics.
- [ ] It links generic testing and Neural Link references instead of copying commands or tool catalogs.

## Out of Scope

A full test inventory, CI redesign, or fixing current DockLayouts defects.

## Avoided Traps

Do not run default Playwright, claim zero tests as green, use fixed sleeps as semantic evidence, or collapse worker truth and painted DOM into one plane.

## Activation Gate

Do not author the guide while #17836 remains an active refactoring authority. At pickup, re-run Memory Core mining, read the current ADR 0029 and source/test surfaces named below, exercise the relevant live subsystem, and revalidate the proposed guide boundary. If the final API makes this split wrong, reshape this ticket before writing—do not preserve a stale outline.
